card.title: Parts that are serialized on iPhones

source.title: Parts that are serialized on iPhones

symptoms: Touch ID / Face ID lost after part swap

claims.statement: iPhone 5S to 8 Plus: only the home button is paired; replacing it loses Touch ID; on 7/7 Plus/8/8 Plus the click also stops working.

iPhone X onward: dot projector and IR camera can't be replaced without losing Face ID (dot projector can be repaired); proximity/flood illuminator pairing applies X–12 series; screen swap loses True Tone on X/XS/XR unless data is copied.

Battery pairing ('unable to determine if genuine') starts with XS/XR and SE 2020/2022; iPhone 11 adds the non-genuine display message; iPhone 12 adds rear camera pairing; Pro models also pair LiDAR (needs JCID programming).
iPhone 13 stopped pairing the proximity/flood illuminator; from iPhone 16 on, swapping the IR camera and dot projector is supported, leaving screen, battery, rear camera and LiDAR serialized.

procedure: Look up the model's paired parts before quoting.
Warn customers about lost Touch ID/Face ID/True Tone or genuine-part messages.
card.caveats: The source table is inconsistent in places (e.g. some 13–15 rows still mention prox/flood pairing). Community-written Repair Wiki page, paraphrased; check the linked page (and its images) before acting on a reading.
